description: Version of the schema used to structure the battery passport instance.
notes: 旧工程字段；官方1.0.0未定义同名独立字段，不等同contentSpecificationIds。

description: Current status of the battery passport as a digital resource.
notes: 当前行同时混有旧业务状态与官方有效性枚举，描述保持中性，不加入初始未激活规则。

description: Level at which the product identifier applies: model, batch or individual item.
notes: 描述通用粒度含义，不把本行旧枚举当作当前EV允许值。

description: Date and time when the battery passport was most recently updated.
notes: 不加入BMS绝不更新或仅状态变化才更新的未确认限制。

description: Unique identifier assigned to an instance of the battery passport.
Unique product identifier used to identify the individual battery.
notes: 描述语义标识含义，不把注册接口HTTPS规则扩写为语义格式约束。

description: Identifier used to distinguish the battery model from other models.
Serial number used to identify the individual battery unit.
notes: 删除旧英文中序列号必然包含批次信息的额外要求。

description: Identifiers of the content specifications governing the battery passport structure.
Unique identifier assigned to the manufacturer of the battery.
notes: 工程扩展标识；官方1.0.0未定义同名独立字段。

description: Unique identifier assigned to the facility associated with the battery.
notes: 工程扩展标识；不将其等同manufacturingPlace邮政地址。

description: Unique identifier assigned to the economic operator responsible for the battery.
notes: 工程扩展标识；不等同官方registrantIdentity名称。

description: Battery category defined according to its intended application and regulatory classification.
notes: 不把工程枚举BESS误写为官方三类之外的新类别。

description: Total mass of the battery, expressed in the specified unit.
Current lifecycle status of the individual battery, such as original or remanufactured.
Geographical location of the plant where the battery was manufactured.
notes: 官方定义是实际生产地点，不是制造商注册地址。

description: Country or jurisdiction where the battery manufacturing plant is located.
Town or city where the battery manufacturing plant is located.
Region where the battery manufacturing plant is geographically located.
notes: 工程项是地区；不把中文详细地址直译为street address。

description: Year and month in which the battery was manufactured.
Date of first intended use in the EU without prior placement on the market.
notes: 工程扩展字段，保留putting into service含义而非任意首次使用。

description: Name of the manufacturer responsible for manufacturing the battery.
Registered trade name under which the battery manufacturer conducts business.
notes: 与名称、商标分开描述，不加入三项同时必填。

description: Registered trademark used to identify the manufacturer of the battery.
Postal address at which the battery manufacturer can be contacted.
Website address providing online access to the battery manufacturer's information.
Email address used to contact the manufacturer of the battery.
Name of the economic operator associated with the battery passport.
notes: 本行是经济运营商名称拆项；不将整组商号商标等伪称官方独立子字段。

description: Registered trade name under which the economic operator conducts business.
notes: 工程扩展，官方1.0.0无此独立语义子字段。

description: Registered trademark used to identify the economic operator's business.
notes: 工程扩展，官方1.0.0无此独立语义子字段。

description: Postal address at which the economic operator can be contacted.
notes: 工程扩展，官方1.0.0无此独立语义子字段。

description: Website address providing online access to the economic operator's information.
notes: 工程扩展，官方1.0.0无此独立语义子字段。

description: Email address used to contact the economic operator for the battery.
notes: 工程扩展，官方1.0.0无此独立语义子字段。

description: Duration of the battery's commercial calendar-life warranty, expressed in months.
notes: 官方TTL明示months，非年月日期。

description: Period covered by the battery's commercial warranty for calendar life.
notes: 歧义：工程项带YYYYMM且数据格式为Date，官方commercialWarrantyPeriod为月数。英文仅描述质保期限含义，不伪称官方年月日期格式，也不擅自定义起始月或到期月。

description: Extinguishing agents suitable for use in a fire involving the battery.
notes: 不新增具体灭火剂枚举或适用条件。

description: Indicates whether the battery bears the symbol for separate collection.
notes: E工程项为分类收集标识；中文与枚举同时混入chemicalSymbol镉铅组合。草稿按工程项描述，建议主代理检查是否本行实为组合显示。

description: Label displaying the battery's carbon footprint and carbon footprint performance class.
notes: 按工程名描述，不宣称此字段已在官方1.0.0语义包启用。

description: Explanation of the meanings of labels and symbols displayed on the battery.
EU declaration confirming the battery's conformity with applicable requirements under Article 18.
notes: 电池DoC，非整车CoC；不增加PDF限定。

description: Test report results demonstrating compliance with the Batteries Regulation and acts adopted under it.
notes: 不规定第三方出具、不造固定报告清单、不限PDF。

description: Reports documenting tests for prohibited or restricted substances in the battery.
notes: 原表工程拆分资料类；不将REACH/SVHC或任意检测项目写成官方固定必交清单。

description: Technical documentation supporting the declared recycled material content of the battery.
notes: 工程拆分资料类；不加入必须第三方认证的要求。

description: Technical documentation describing the battery's performance and durability assessment results.
notes: 工程拆分资料类。

description: Documentation describing the battery's state of health and expected lifetime.
notes: 工程拆分资料类，不等同某一个SOH数值字段。

description: Technical documentation demonstrating the battery's conformity with applicable regulatory requirements.
notes: 工程拆分资料类，不将全部技术文档都归为测试报告。

description: Instructions for using the battery in a printable, downloadable and storable format.
notes: 不复制中文中对综合法案/暂不填的未核实解释。

description: Battery carbon footprint per kilowatt-hour of energy delivered over its expected lifetime.
notes: 保留功能单位含义，不重复长法律段落。

description: Contribution of raw material acquisition and preprocessing to the battery's carbon footprint.
Contribution of the main production stage to the battery's carbon footprint.
Contribution of the distribution stage to the battery's carbon footprint.
Contribution of end-of-life treatment and recycling to the battery's carbon footprint.
Performance class indicating the battery's relative lifecycle carbon footprint level.
notes: 不增加A至E已被法规固定等要求。

description: Total absolute carbon footprint attributable to the battery's lifecycle.
Publicly accessible study supporting the battery's declared carbon footprint results.
Report describing battery supply-chain due diligence policies, risk management and verification activities.
notes: 不把所有报告都强制为第三方出具。

description: Information on supply-chain assurances provided by third parties through recognised schemes.
notes: 名称本身为第三方供应链保证，保留third parties，不新增强制认证。

description: Indices providing information relevant to the assessment of the battery's supply chain.
Electrochemical chemistry of the battery, reflecting its active materials and electrolyte.
notes: 不保留旧英文电解质自愿披露的未经本字段确认限定。

description: Critical raw materials identified as being present in the battery.
notes: 按主代理指定仅描述critical raw materials；不在英文描述重复阈值和清单数量。

description: Name of a material used in the battery's cathode.
notes: 官方detailedComposition下工程拆分；不伪造官方结构化子字段。

description: CAS Registry Number identifying a material used in the battery's cathode.
notes: 工程拆分，不声称CAS为官方独立必填子字段。

description: Name of a material used in the battery's anode.
notes: 纠正negative material为anode material。

description: CAS Registry Number identifying a material used in the battery's anode.
notes: 工程拆分，不声称CAS为官方独立必填子字段。

description: Name of a material used in the battery's electrolyte.
CAS Registry Number identifying a material used in the battery's electrolyte.
notes: 工程拆分，不声称CAS为官方独立必填子字段。

description: Names of hazardous substances present in the battery, excluding mercury, cadmium and lead.
notes: 按官方TTL保留除Hg/Cd/Pb外的含义；不复制旧文中SVHC与0.1%限定。

description: CAS Registry Number used to identify a hazardous substance in the battery.
notes: 工程拆分，不声称CAS为官方独立必填子字段。

description: Hazard classes and categories assigned to substances present in the battery.
notes: 工程拆分；不指定未确认的分类体系。

description: Location of a hazardous substance within the battery or its components.
notes: 原英文为0，已按工程项补全。

description: Concentration of a hazardous substance present in the battery.
notes: 不添加本行未明确的单位或统一阈值。

description: Effects of battery substances on the environment, human health and personal safety.
Share of nickel in battery active materials recovered from pre-consumer waste.
notes: 工程细分；不冒充1.0.0当前可用字段。

description: Share of cobalt in battery active materials recovered from pre-consumer waste.
notes: 工程细分；不冒充1.0.0当前可用字段。

description: Share of lithium in battery active materials recovered from pre-consumer waste.
notes: 工程细分；不冒充1.0.0当前可用字段。

description: Share of nickel in battery active materials recovered from post-consumer waste.
notes: 工程细分；不冒充1.0.0当前可用字段。

description: Share of cobalt in battery active materials recovered from post-consumer waste.
notes: 工程细分；不冒充1.0.0当前可用字段。

description: Share of lithium in battery active materials recovered from post-consumer waste.
notes: 工程细分；不冒充1.0.0当前可用字段。

description: Share of recycled lead contained in the battery's active materials.
notes: 不擅自限定仅消费前或消费后。

description: Proportion of renewable content incorporated into the battery, expressed as a percentage.
notes: 官方为renewable content，不是制造过程中可再生能源的占比。

description: Instructions for removing the battery pack and dismantling its components.
notes: 工程项含拆除/拆卸指南；按父语义描述，未将文档分拆方式写成强制要求。
